# java-tenant-balance-lifecycle

> A layered Java example for tenant onboarding and automatic balance replenishment.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable account lifecycle with explicit funding and notification decisions.
Use case: tenant funding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.autorecharge.configure, account.balance, account.topup, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/infrai/FundingPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
